observations: Photo 0 shows two black Xbox controllers stacked on top of a black console, with a textured surface and visible wear.
Photo 1 shows the same console with two controllers and a power brick with a USB cable, placed on a textured surface.
Photo 2 shows the console with two controllers and a power brick, with visible scratches and wear on the console surface.
All photos show the console and controllers from the front and side angles, with no visible games or accessories.
The console has a textured right side with diagonal lines, typical of Xbox One models.
The controllers have standard Xbox button layout with colored buttons (A, B, X, Y) and analog sticks.
The power brick is black with a USB connector, consistent with Xbox One power supply.
No games, cables, or other accessories are visible in any photo.
The console appears to be a standard Xbox One model, but no model number or serial is visible.

risks.proof: Video of both controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game, or a close-up of button response.

risks.risk: Games may be missing, damaged, or not included
risks.proof: Photos of all six games with their cases or discs, or a video of the games being loaded and played.
